data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'azza', meaning 'to be strong, mighty, or brave'. This name holds significant spiritual meaning in Islam, as it reflects the courage and resilience of the faithful. The name Azziz carries the meaning “Strong, Brave” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Azziz usually hope their child will grow to embody strong, brave and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Azziz total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_urdu.name: عزیز
in_urdu.long_meaning: عزیز ایک معروف نام ہے جو عربی زبان سے نکلا ہے، اس کا مطلب قوی، پیارا اور شریف ہوتا ہے، یہ نام اسلامی تقویم میں بہت اہمیت رکھتا ہے کیونکہ یہ قرآن مجید میں ذکر ہوا ہے، خاص طور پر سورہ آل عمران اور سورہ فرقان میں

in_english.name: Azziz
in_english.long_meaning: Azziz is a masculine given name of Arabic origin, meaning strong, beloved, and noble. It is derived from the Arabic root ʿ-z-z, which conveys the idea of strength and power. The name Azziz is mentioned in the Quran, specifically in Surah Al Imran and Surah Al Furqan, emphasizing its significance in Islamic tradition. It symbolizes strength, dignity, and high esteem.

data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Azziz is a reminder of the power and might of Allah (God), and the inner strength that faith can provide in times of adversity. It also represents the concept of 'Tawakkul' or 'Reliance on God', encouraging the bearer to trust in the divine support and guidance, and to face challenges with the spirit of courage and resistance. In this manner, the name Azziz holds profound spiritual significance for many Muslims, embodying both the human and divine aspects of strength and resilience.
